column4: Note 1:The control region consists of PCFICH, PHICH and PDCCH.Note 2:DCI formats are defined in TS 36.212.Note 3:DCI format shall depend upon the test configuration.Note 4:Cell ID shall depend upon the test configuration.Note 5:Payload size shall depend upon the test configuration.Note 6:Only 2 OFDM symbols for special subframes 1 and 6.Note 7:For PDCCH using SI/RA/P-RNTI, Aggregation level 4 is used.
